sourceTitle: Google Analytics Help: Prepare for Google Play's data disclosure requirements

types.quote: Collects screen views and sessions for use in Reporting and Analysis.
Derives coarse location data from the masked IP addresses of the device.

note: The page also says the developer is "solely responsible for deciding how to respond to Google Play's Data safety section form". With consent mode's analytics_storage denied, Google's consent-mode page (updated 2026-07-30) says the SDK "Won't read or write first-party analytics cookies or app identifiers" while "signals (apps) will be sent", so a lookup after Reject is not by itself an identifier.

sourceTitle: Firebase: Google Play's data disclosure requirements for Firebase Android SDKs

types.quote: Collects stack traces when an application crashes.
Generates and stores the Crashlytics installation UUID to measure the number of users impacted by a crash.

note: The page says: "Firebase does not transfer this data to third-parties except:" to its subprocessors and as the developer instructs. It does not use Play's category names; the mapping is TraceVeil's reading.

sourceTitle: Google Mobile Ads SDK: Google Play data disclosure
sharesQuote: collects and shares the following data types automatically for advertising, analytics, and fraud prevention purposes.

types.quote: Collects user product interactions and interaction information, including app launch, taps, and video views.
Diagnostic information ... including app launch time, hang rate, and energy usage
Collects device's IP address, which may be used to estimate the general location of a device.

sourceTitle: Meta for Developers: Resources for completing app store data practice questionnaires for apps that include the Facebook or Audience Network SDK (18 Jul 2022)

types.quote: We may also receive and process the following information if your app is integrated with the Facebook SDK: ... Device identifiers;
there are app events that are automatically logged (app installs, app launches, and in-app purchases)

note: The post does not use Play's category names; the mapping is TraceVeil's reading. Automatic app event logging can be turned off by the developer.

sourceTitle: Meta for Developers: Resources for completing app store data practice questionnaires for apps that include the Facebook or Audience Network SDK (18 Jul 2022)

types.quote: We may receive and process the following information when you use the Audience Network SDK ... Device identifiers;
Ad performance information, such as impressions, clicks, placement, and viewability.

note: The post does not use Play's category names; the mapping is TraceVeil's reading.

types.quote: Disables collection of various Advertising IDs by the SDK. ... This includes Google Advertising ID (GAID), OAID and Amazon Advertising ID (AAID).

note: The first quote describes the switch that turns advertising-ID collection off, so it applies unless the app uses that switch; in-app events are sent when the app logs them. AppsFlyer's own Data safety help article (support.appsflyer.com/hc/en-us/articles/4417197430289) could not be read (HTTP 403), so it is not used.
